Generate PSOC-classified occupations

Source: R/psoc.R
fkr_psoc_occupation.Rd

Draws occupation titles from the Philippine Standard Occupational Classification (PSOC), the Philippine Statistics Authority's official occupational taxonomy (aligned with ISCO-08), together with their real classification code.

Usage

fkr_psoc_occupation(
  n,
  level = c("unit", "minor", "sub-major", "major"),
  major_group = NULL
)

Arguments

n

Number of occupations to generate. A single non-negative whole number.

level

PSOC hierarchy level to draw from: "unit" (most specific, e.g. "Finance managers"), "minor", "sub-major", or "major" (broadest, e.g. "Managers"). Default "unit".

major_group

Optional major-group title to restrict the draw to (e.g. "Professionals", "Elementary Occupations"). See fkr_psoc_occupation()'s major_group output column for valid values.

Value

A data.frame with n rows and columns title (the occupation/group title), psoc_code (its PSOC code), and major_group (its top-level PSOC major-group title).

Details

Data is fetched live via the phscs package (which caches its data locally after the first call) and kept in memory for the rest of the R session, so the first call in a session may require network access.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
fkr_psoc_occupation(5)
fkr_psoc_occupation(5, level = "major")
fkr_psoc_occupation(5, major_group = "Professionals")
}
